description:
Anbernic just dropped the brand new RG SP, and it might be the ultimate Game Boy Advance SP clone. Let's unbox it, test the H700 chip, and see if it's worth your money!

Buy The New RG SP Here: https://anbernic.com/store/1101412986

The Anbernic RG SP is finally here, ditching the analog sticks of the older 34XX and 35XX models to bring us a 10% thinner, true-to-form clamshell retro handheld. If you grew up with the original GBA SP, the nostalgia here is off the charts. We are taking a deep dive into the hardware, comparing it side-by-side with the original Nintendo classic, and testing the new 3.4-inch 3:2 IPS display.
